title: The limits of exactness: On the failure of automatic differentiation in physics-informed machine learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.33078v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Automatic differentiation (AD) lets neural networks compute derivatives of governing equations to machine precision, and this precision has made it the computational backbone of physics-informed machine learning. Yet exactness in the mathematical sense is not the same as fidelity to the physics. Here I argue that a derivative can be numerically perfect and still be the wrong derivative for the problem at hand, because AD, by construction, has no notion of the physical structure a solution must obey. Convection and its associated directionality, diffusion, and dispersion are only the most visible instances of a much longer list that spans all branches of computational science and engineering, including conservation, thermodynamic consistency, symmetry, symplectic structure, positivity, monotonicity, and boundedness. Recognizing this broader gap reframes how the field should build the next generation of PDE-driven neural surrogates.

translated_title: 精确性的极限：论自动微分在物理信息机器学习中的失效
translated_abstract: 自动微分（AD）使神经网络能够以机器精度计算控制方程的导数，正是这种精度使其成为物理信息机器学习的计算基石。然而，数学意义上的精确并不等同于对物理的忠实。本文论证：一个导数可以在数值上完美无缺，却仍然是针对当前问题的错误导数，因为自动微分在其构造上并不知晓解所必须遵循的物理结构。对流及其相关的方向性、扩散和色散只是这一更长清单中最显眼的例子，该清单涵盖计算科学与工程的所有分支，包括守恒性、热力学一致性、对称性、辛结构、正性、单调性和有界性。认识到这一更广泛的缺口，将重新定义该领域应如何构建下一代由偏微分方程驱动的神经代理模型。
tldr: 本文指出自动微分虽能以机器精度求导，但由于其构造上不具备对物理结构（如守恒性、对称性、正性等）的感知能力，数值上完美的导数仍可能是物理上错误的导数，从而揭示了物理信息机器学习的根本局限。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that automatic differentiation, despite achieving machine-precision derivatives, is structurally blind to the physical properties (conservation, symmetry, positivity, etc.) that solutions must obey, meaning a numerically perfect derivative can still be the wrong derivative for physics-informed machine learning.
